findings.summary: The new status line starts `Status: **implemented —`. That matches plan-lifecycle's PROMOTED_VERDICT (`/status:\s*\*\*\s*implemented\b/i`), so `node .agents/conventions/tools/plan-lifecycle.mjs` now exits 1 with 'misfiled todo/PLAN_vibe_and_kimi_runtimes_E5.md — its status reads as promoted'. This CI family check passed at b4e2ea96, where the status said 'in progress'. The plan is also not done: E5.4–E5.6 are not reviewed, the J2 live checks have not run, and M-K17 has not run.
findings.fix: Keep the status as `**in progress — …**` (for example 'E5.1–E5.7 implemented; E5.4–E5.6 not yet reviewed; J2 live checks and M-K17 not run') until the plan is promoted.

findings.summary: `dotnet format … --verify-no-changes` reports 'error WHITESPACE: Fix whitespace formatting. Delete 4 characters' at (145,13), in the conditional lambda block given to `During`. CI runs this step (.github/workflows/ci.yml:49), and the plan's DoD requires it to be clean.
findings.fix: Run `dotnet format dew_flow_connect_other_ais.slnx --include src_mcp/tests/AKimiQuestionRowTests.cs` and commit the result.

findings.summary: Kimi rows are now admitted with AdmissionFlag.Unconfined. That flag's caveat is shown in the settings, the sidebar and the log, and it says 'can read this machine — a shell is always there, and no flag removes it'. For Kimi this is false: every shell command is refused (M-K3, M-K4), and the reach is Grep and Glob (M-K6). The same text is in src_vs_code/src/capabilityAdmission.ts:60.
findings.fix: Change the shared caveat to words that are true for every unconfined runtime (for example 'can read this machine — nothing coai sets confines what it reads'), in C# and TS together. Or record the wording as an open item. Make sure the TS test still matches /can read this machine/.

findings.summary: MustBeTheShimsConfinement has cyclomatic complexity 5 by Roslyn's count (if, &&, ||, ||). The plan's §0 and csharp.doctrine §6 set the limit at ≤ 4 per method.
findings.fix: Move the test into a predicate with no branch operators, for example `private static bool CarriesArgv(Confinement.Planned p) => p.Flags.Count + p.Leading.Count + p.AddDirs.Count > 0;`.

findings.summary: S5.6.6 only puts the extra argv in Flags (`["--yolo"]`). Deviation 49 widened the refusal to Leading and AddDirs, but no test covers them. If you delete `plan.Leading.Count > 0 ||` or `plan.AddDirs.Count > 0`, every test stays green.
findings.fix: Make S5.6.6 a Theory with three arms: one plan carries Flags, one carries Leading, one carries AddDirs. Each must throw ArgumentException that names the shim.

findings.summary: S5.6.7 is only partly asserted. (a) The fixture puts `src/AGENTS.md` (KESTREL-9) and `src/.kimi-code/config.toml` into the granted root, but the test never checks that the copy Kimi reads leaves them out, although the disk row's note claims a sanitised snapshot. (b) The refused and cancelled arms never check that the row's own `coai-question-*` scratch is gone. Only coai-vh is checked, and the copy is checked only in the answered arm. The table's Then asks for 'the row's scratch and coai-vh\<8> are gone' after each ending.
findings.fix: In the answered arm, assert that no copy contains AGENTS.md or .kimi-code. In the cancelled arm, record the started shim's WorkingDirectory and assert that its parent folder is gone. In the refused arm, assert that no new `coai-question-*` folder is left.

findings.summary: `_data` and `_temp` are made with `Directory.CreateTempSubdirectory("coai-kcheck-data-")` and `("coai-kcheck-temp-")`. They do not have the `testsToDelete-` prefix that test-leftovers.md and the plan's §0 require. After a crashed run, `_temp` can keep a `coai-check-*/own/kh-*` home that holds a junction, and the sweep would not find it.
findings.fix: Use `TempDir.For("testsToDelete-kimi-check-data-")` and `TempDir.For("testsToDelete-kimi-check-temp-")`, and dispose them like `_homes`.
